import inspect

import solution


def test_issue_example_12_years():
    """Example asserts dog_age(12) equals 61."""
    assert solution.dog_age(12) == 61  # 2*10.5 + 10*4 = 21+40 = 61


def test_issue_zero_years():
    """Zero human years is zero dog years."""
    assert solution.dog_age(0) == 0  # 0*10.5 = 0


def test_issue_one_year():
    """First human year counts as 10.5 dog years."""
    assert solution.dog_age(1) == 10.5  # 1*10.5 = 10.5


def test_issue_two_years():
    """First two human years count 10.5 dog years each."""
    assert solution.dog_age(2) == 21  # 2*10.5 = 21


def test_issue_three_years():
    """Each human year after two adds 4 dog years."""
    assert solution.dog_age(3) == 25  # 2*10.5 + 1*4 = 21+4 = 25


def test_issue_four_years():
    """Each human year after two adds 4 dog years."""
    assert solution.dog_age(4) == 29  # 2*10.5 + 2*4 = 21+8 = 29


def test_issue_five_years():
    """Each human year after two adds 4 dog years."""
    assert solution.dog_age(5) == 33  # 2*10.5 + 3*4 = 21+12 = 33


def test_issue_ten_years():
    """Each human year after two adds 4 dog years."""
    assert solution.dog_age(10) == 53  # 2*10.5 + 8*4 = 21+32 = 53


def test_issue_twenty_years():
    """Each human year after two adds 4 dog years."""
    assert solution.dog_age(20) == 93  # 2*10.5 + 18*4 = 21+72 = 93


def test_contract_callable():
    """Public interface requires solution.dog_age to exist and be callable."""
    assert callable(solution.dog_age)


def test_contract_single_argument():
    """Public interface requires dog_age(h_age) to take one argument."""
    sig = inspect.signature(solution.dog_age)
    assert len(sig.parameters) == 1


def test_contract_returns_number_deterministically():
    """Public interface requires dog_age to return a deterministic number."""
    first = solution.dog_age(12)
    second = solution.dog_age(12)
    assert isinstance(first, (int, float))
    assert first == second
